preconditions.expression: isinstance(arr, list) and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: arr is a list of strings
the length of arr is between 1 and 1000

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 30 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: each string in arr has a length between 1 and 30

postconditions.description: the return value is a string

postconditions.expression: all(prefix in arr for prefix in return_value[:i] for i in range(1, len(return_value) + 1))

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) < len(return_value) or (len(s) == len(return_value) and s >= return_value) for s in arr if all(prefix in arr for prefix in s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1)))
postconditions.description: the return value is the longest lexicographically smallest string among all strings in arr that satisfy the prefix condition
